verdicts.why: Claire's only Jessica Jones S1 episode is 'AKA Smile' (E13), where she treats Luke at Jessica's apartment and meets Malcolm.
He Who Remains first appears in S1E6, where he says he found Alioth and used it to end the Multiversal War.
Miss Minutes is first shown working for He Who Remains in S1E6, when she makes his offer to Loki and Sylvie at the Citadel.

value.title: Loki S1#5
value.text: Miss Minutes helps Renslayer string Sylvie along with a search for a Void timecraft that does not exist, while secretly calling in Minutemen.
value.on_a_card_about_b: A variant Miss Minutes strings along with a fake timecraft.
value.on_b_card_about_a: The TVA's A.I., who strings Sylvie along with a fake timecraft.

split.title: Loki S1#6
split.text: Miss Minutes appears to Sylvie and Loki at the Citadel at the End of Time, offering them a deal from He Who Remains.
split.on_a_card_about_b: A variant Miss Minutes strings along with a fake timecraft, then offers a deal.
split.on_b_card_about_a: The TVA's A.I., who strings Sylvie along, then offers He Who Remains' deal.

verdicts.why: The fake timecraft search is S1E5, but the Citadel deal is S1E6, so moving the whole stage to #5 leaks E6; split the deal out to #6.
The S1E4 mid-credits scene has four Loki variants, Kid Loki among them, meet Loki in the Void and invite him along; his rule, his Thor and the Alioth help are S1E5.
The S1E4 mid-credits scene has Alligator Loki among the four variants who meet Loki in the Void and take him along.
Classic Loki is one of the four variants who meet Loki at the end of S1E4; his backstory and death at Alioth are S1E5.
In S1E5 Boastful Loki leads President Loki's army to the bunker for the throne; President Loki tries to keep it, and his army turns on him, not on Loki.

value.title: Loki S2#1
value.text: General Dox sends a team of TVA hunters out to find Sylvie.
value.on_b_card_about_a: TVA general who sends hunters after Sylvie.

split.title: Loki S2#2
split.text: Sylvie learns that Dox's hunters are out to destroy the branched timelines and helps Loki and Mobius capture Dox, but most of Dox's plan has already worked.
split.on_a_card_about_b: Variant Dox leads the hunters against.
split.on_b_card_about_a: TVA general who leads the hunters against Sylvie.

verdicts.why: The move to S2E1 is right, but the split text is wrong: in S2E2 Dox is captured only after her plan has largely succeeded, so they do not 'stop' the hunters.

value.title: Loki S2#1
value.text: Miss Minutes runs most of the Temporal Loom's work, while Ouroboros only checks in to run diagnostics every few hundred years.
value.on_a_card_about_b: The Loom's technician, who runs its diagnostics every few hundred years.
value.on_b_card_about_a: The A.I. that does most of the Loom's work.

split.title: Loki S2#4
split.text: When Miss Minutes sabotages the effort to save the Loom, Ouroboros reboots the system to shut her down.
split.on_a_card_about_b: The Loom's technician, who reboots the system to shut Miss Minutes down.
split.on_b_card_about_a: The Loom's A.I., who sabotages it until Ouroboros shuts her down.

split.title: Loki S2#6
split.text: Ouroboros reprograms Miss Minutes and starts her up again to help the new TVA.
split.on_a_card_about_b: The Loom's technician, who shuts Miss Minutes down, then reprograms her.
split.on_b_card_about_a: The Loom's A.I., who sabotages it until Ouroboros shuts her down and reprograms her.

verdicts.why: Ouroboros tells Mobius in S2E1 that Miss Minutes does most of the Loom's work while he runs diagnostics every few hundred years, so #2 is too late; the sabotage and shutdown are S2E4 and the reprogramming S2E6, so they are split out.

value.title: Loki S2#2
value.text: After He Who Remains dies, Miss Minutes goes rogue with Renslayer and helps her move through time.
value.on_a_card_about_b: Goes rogue with Miss Minutes after He Who Remains dies.
value.on_b_card_about_a: Renslayer's rogue partner after He Who Remains dies.

split.title: Loki S2#3
split.text: Miss Minutes and Renslayer hunt for Victor Timely, hoping to put him in He Who Remains' place with them at his side.
split.on_a_card_about_b: Goes rogue with Miss Minutes, hunting Victor Timely.
split.on_b_card_about_a: Renslayer's rogue partner after He Who Remains dies, hunting Victor Timely.

split.title: Loki S2#4
split.text: Miss Minutes tells Renslayer about her past with He Who Remains, and the two drop their plan for Victor and try to take over the TVA themselves.
split.on_a_card_about_b: Tries to take over the TVA with Miss Minutes.
split.on_b_card_about_a: Renslayer's partner in trying to take over the TVA.

verdicts.why: S2E2 first shows Miss Minutes helping the rogue Renslayer, and the Timely hunt is S2E3, but their bid to take over the TVA themselves is S2E4, so 'take back the TVA' is cut from the #3 stage and given its own #4 stage.
In S2E3 Timely follows Miss Minutes' advice and leaves Renslayer behind, then switches her off when she says she could be much more to him.

value.title: Loki S2#3
value.text: Loki tracks down Victor Timely, a variant of He Who Remains, and takes him to the TVA to help fix the failing Temporal Loom.
value.on_a_card_about_b: A variant of He Who Remains Loki brings to fix the Loom.
value.on_b_card_about_a: The god who brings Victor to the TVA to fix the Loom.

split.title: Loki S2#4
split.text: Loki and Sylvie rescue Victor from Renslayer, but when Victor goes out to save the Loom, its radiation tears him apart.
split.on_a_card_about_b: A variant of He Who Remains Loki brings to fix the Loom, who dies there.
split.on_b_card_about_a: The god who brings Victor to the Loom and rescues him from Renslayer.

split.title: Loki S2#6
split.text: Loki relives the moment of Victor's death again and again trying to save him.
split.on_a_card_about_b: A variant of He Who Remains Loki brings to fix the Loom.
split.on_b_card_about_a: The god who brings Victor to the Loom and keeps trying to save him.

verdicts.why: Timely first appears in S2E3, but the stage text also covers his death at the Loom (S2E4) and Loki reliving it (S2E6), so those are split out.
X-5, as Brad Wolfe, prunes D-90 and kidnaps Timely for Renslayer in S2E4.
S2E3 ends with Loki and Mobius taking Timely to the TVA; the work on the Loom is S2E4.
Renslayer first confronts the Variant at the TVA in S1E3; the childhood arrest flashback and the sword-point demand are both S1E4.
He Who Remains first appears and dies in the S1 finale (E6).
Loki slips back to the Citadel and talks with He Who Remains only in S2E6.
In S2E2 X-5 gives up only Sylvie's location to Loki; Dox's plan comes out when Sylvie enchants him.
Bobby meets Claire at the Train Diner lunch in S1E6 and sits in the back of Pop's as she talks Luke into fighting on in S1E7.
In S2E1 D.W. sells Luke merchandise in Pop's, and he and Bobby usher out a fan filming for footage; they have no scenes together in S1.

value.title: Luke Cage S1#1
value.text: Bobby Fish is a regular at Pop's barbershop, where Luke works, and the two talk basketball with the other regulars.
value.on_a_card_about_b: Works at Pop's, where Bobby is a regular.

split.title: Luke Cage S1#3
split.text: After Pop's death, Bobby and Luke work together to keep Pop's open, and Bobby stays a loyal friend to Luke.
split.on_a_card_about_b: A loyal friend from Pop's barbershop.
split.on_b_card_about_a: A loyal friend and Pop's regular.

verdicts.why: They already share Pop's in S1E1 (Luke talks basketball there with Pop, Shameek, Chico and Bobby), so #3 is too late for the start; the friendship that saves the shop is S1E3 and goes in its own stage.
Bobby is at Pop's arguing about the Knicks in S1E1; he tells Luke the Marcus Garvey Park chess story and helps save the shop in S1E3, after Pop dies in S1E2.

verdicts.why: The S2E4 move is right, but the old text's 'first fights' also covers the second beating at High Bridge in S2E6, which the proposal dropped; it gets its own #6 stage.
In S2E4 Misty sees the video, finds Garrison's body and talks to the building owner who grew up with Bushmaster; the 'Babylon's finest' questioning is the S2E8 search of Harlem's Paradise.
Ridley returns to command the precinct in S2E9 and has Bushmaster arrested there.

In S1E3 Cottonmouth fires the missile into Genghis Connie's himself to get at Luke, and Connie is buried with Luke.
In S1E1 Misty watches Cottonmouth at the club, then investigates the junkyard deal and impounds his Hammer weapons; his arrest comes later.
In S1E1 Tone already works for Cottonmouth and brings him Dante's leads; Cottonmouth throws him off the roof in S1E2.
In S1E9 'DWYCK' Zip goes to work for Diamondback and talks him out of shooting Shades.
Diamondback's 'you buy or you die' threat to Colon is S1E9; Colon's failed attack and death are S1E12.
In S1E8 Diamondback admits he put Luke in Seagate, wants revenge, and reveals they are brothers.
Tone kills Pop in S1E2; Luke's campaign against Cottonmouth starts in S1E3.
Ridley takes over the precinct in S1E7, sees Luke across the street and presses Misty about his vigilantism.
